test_logcat_thread_set_filters: test that LogcatThread applies log filters correctly when initialized with a LogParsingConfig
test_logcat_thread_kill: test that calling kill on LogcatThread stops the underlying log stream and joins the thread
test_logcat_thread_listeners: test that EventListener callbacks fire when log messages match a registered regex pattern
test_logcat_thread_resume_recreates: test that resume recreates the daemon thread after kill stops it
test_fake_log_stream: test the FakeLogStream helper class that wraps FakeStream to simulate ADB log output for unit tests
